policy.statement: Only artifacts whose code AND weights are distributed under a commercially usable license are listed in the standard package. Unclear-rights separators (HT-Demucs, KUIELab/UVR MDX mirrors, Open-Unmix) are never downloaded by ChampionVibe; users may import their own local files through BYOM and carry the responsibility for those weights.
policy.pinRule: Every cleared artifact carries a 64-hex SHA-256 pin. A pin that has not been verified against the upstream bytes (PENDING_VERIFICATION) makes the artifact non-installable instead of silently trusted.

artifacts.title: Spleeter 2-stem (ONNX)
artifacts.purpose: Default local separator: acapella + instrumental, CPU, Windows + Android
artifacts.upstreamStatement: JOSS 5(50):2154, doi:10.21105/joss.02154, by the Spleeter authors: "Spleeter source code and pre-trained models are available on github and distributed under a MIT license." The repository README licenses "the code" and ships the same MIT LICENSE file; retain the MIT notice with any redistribution.
artifacts.rightsNote: Cleared for the default package: MIT weights exported by an Apache-2.0 converter, no restricted training corpus (Spleeter was trained on Deezer's own internal dataset, unlike MUSDB-HQ-based separators). Residual review item: the Spleeter README names only "the code" while the authors' peer-reviewed paper names code and pretrained models; keep both statements in the bundled notices.

artifacts.title: Spleeter 2-stem (ONNX, FP16, low memory)
artifacts.purpose: Optional lower-memory variant of the default separator for Android devices
artifacts.upstreamStatement: Converted from the same MIT-licensed Spleeter 2stems checkpoint with onnxmltools float16 conversion (weights only; IO types stay float32).
artifacts.rightsNote: Same clearance as the FP32 default. FP16 storage can alter numerics slightly; the FP32 artifact stays the reference for verification.

byom.statement: Bring Your Own Model (BYOM) never downloads and never redistributes weights. Dropped .onnx/.cvmodel.json files stay on the user's device, are validated for structure and tensor shapes only, and the app stores the local path plus the file hash in byom-models.json.

acceptedKinds.contract: two Spleeter U-Net graphs (vocals + accompaniment): float32 input 'x' [2, splits, 512, 1024], float32 output 'y' of identical shape

acceptedKinds.rightsWarning: The Demucs maintainers state that the pretrained weights are not covered by the repository's MIT license and that the models were trained on MUSDB-HQ plus additional data; commercial use of these weights is not cleared. Bring your own file and obtain your own rights.

acceptedKinds.contract: float32 [1, 4, 2048, 512] target graph, selected through a .cvmodel.json manifest
acceptedKinds.rightsWarning: MDX-Net mirrors (KUIELab Track A, UVR) have unclear model and training-data provenance. Bring your own file and obtain your own rights.
